additional_info.subject: RE: ID0483289-DC/Si-D/IT- [Y2 / S7 313806942001] Cu logs check CRM:03288000487
additional_info.body:
Hello,
A customer tried to charge on today 10 of March, thru Credit card, but the charger gave him some errors related to the Pin of his Credit card was not correct, even if he tried with different credit cards. Meanwhile we saw there were some warnings on the charger, so we performed a reboot.
After the reboot the customer tried to charge another time. The recharge was authorized, but it was a 0 recharge: at 08:37:52 a.m. (cu time).
In fact we saw other warnings on the charger.
After some minutes he had a good recharge.
Is it possible to understand if there were problem on the charger during the two first attempts? So between 8:15 a.m. and 8:50 a.m. (cu time) of today 10 of March?
Thank you,
Filomena
